Short title and commencement

SINDH COTTON CONTROL
SINDH COTTON
CONTROL
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th March, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(9)/2002, dated
26‑3‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of section 13A of West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966

SINDH COTTON CONTROL
SINDH COTTON
CONTROL
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th March, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(9)/2002, dated
26‑3‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Insertion of section 13A of
West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966.‑‑In the Sindh Cotton
Control Ordinance, 1966, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, after
section 13, the following new section shall be inserted:‑‑
"13‑A. No Cotton shall
be transported from one place to another in any manner or by any means which
may contaminate it.".

Amendment of section 14 of West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966

No. S. LEGIS: 1(9)/2002, dated
26‑3‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 14 of
West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966.‑‑In the said Ordinance, in
section 14, in subsection (2), for the words "fifty rupees", the
words "ten thousand rupees" and for the words "five hundred
rupees" the words "twenty five thousand rupees" shall be
substituted.

Amendment of section 15 of West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966

SINDH COTTON CONTROL
SINDH COTTON
CONTROL
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th March, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(9)/2002, dated
26‑3‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
4. Amendment of section 15 of
West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966.‑‑In the said Ordinance, in
section 15‑‑
(i)
for subsection (5), the following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(5) The occupier of a
cotton ginning factory whether erected before or after the commencement of this
Ordinance shall provide in the factory‑‑
(a)
such number of de‑linting machine as the prescribed authority may by
order direct;
(b)
a weigh bridge, automatic‑press and moisture‑detectors;
(c)
pre‑cleaners and lint cleaners;
(d)
new ginning saws at the commencement of crop season every year'
(e)
such staffs as are trained in the subjects and in the manner prescribed by the prescribed authority.
(ii)
in subsection (6), before the full stop, the words "and such occupier
shall also provide covered
paved platform in the market for storage of cotton" shall be added.
(iii)
in subsection (7), for the words "three months" the words "six
months" and for the words
"five thousand rupees" the words "ten thousand rupees"
shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 17 of West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966

No. S. LEGIS: 1(9)/2002, dated
26‑3‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
5. Amendment of section 17 of
West Pakistan Ordinance XX of 1966.‑‑In the said Ordinance, in
section 17, in subsection (1), after clause (b), the following new clause shall
be inserted:
"(c) who uses or allows to
use polypropylene bags for picking or storing cotton or handles or facilitates
handling cotton in any cloth made of other than cotton fiber or uses twine made
of any fiber other than cotton."
